name: Pass files between Bash scripts on the Docker task runner
description: Two Bash script tasks on the Docker task runner hand files to each other. The first gets a CSV and a JSON config through Input Files and a title through Environment, aggregates the orders and writes a report and a chart. Output Files keeps only the report and the chart, and the second task reads both back through Input Files.
shortDescription: Hand files from one Bash script task to the next with Input Files and Output Files.
keyFeatures: Inline file contents written into the working directory through Input Files
Output Files glob patterns that decide which files are kept
Stored output files passed to the next task, including into a subdirectory
prerequisites: The Docker task runner enabled with bytechef.script.runners.docker.enabled=true
A Docker daemon the ByteChef server can reach, with internet access to pull images
idealFor: Developers who need a real language runtime, its libraries or local tools in a workflow step, beyond what the sandboxed GraalVM runner allows.
steps: Produce Report reads orders.csv and config.json from Input Files and writes report.csv, charts/summary.txt and scratch.log.
Output Files keeps report.csv and charts/summary.txt and drops scratch.log.
Consume Report gets the two stored files through Input Files and returns what it reads from them.
